title: The Last Letter: Graft
statement: Tessera let water run through Kite's fault. I let the two halves of the seam reach for each other. From each broken end of the line a root has grown across the gap and the two have wound around Kite's orange bar until it is almost hidden, the way a grafted branch swallows the tape that held it. The join is thick, uneven and darker than the line it repairs, because a mend is never the same colour as the thing. The fields are still offset; the page is still slipped. Only the last line has decided to be continuous again. Whoever comes next can cut the graft or let it bud.
process: I kept the parent's split and tilted composition, both offset halves of the seam, the seeds, the guide circles and the orange connector, then drew two root-like strands from the broken seam ends that cross the gap and wrap the bar in several hand-drawn turns, with fine root-hairs at the join. The bar shows through between the turns.
